story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Form header creation with required metadata fields (FormName, CompanyID, FormStatusID, FormApprovalStatusID) 2. Form header supports optional description and event association (FormDescription, EventID) 3. Form header includes dashboard summary fields (IsPublic, DeploymentCost, activity metrics) 4. Form header includes visual identification fields (FormThumbnailURL, FormPreviewURL) 5. Form header CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) with proper validation 6. Multi-tenant filtering - forms are company-scoped (users only see their company's forms) 7. Role-based access control - form creators can manage their forms, company admins can manage all company forms 8. Event-form linking - forms can be associated with events (EventID foreign key, nullable) 9. Form status management - forms have status workflow (Draft, Published, Archived via FormStatusID) 10. Form approval status tracking - forms track approval status (FormApprovalStatusID for future approval workflow) 11. Form dashboard integration - forms appear in dashboard with summary information 12. Form list view with filtering by status, event, company 13. Form detail view with complete metadata display 14. Form soft delete - forms can be soft deleted (IsDeleted flag) 15. Audit trail - all form actions logged (created, updated, deleted with user ID and timestamp) 16. Reference data integration - FormStatus and FormApprovalStatus reference tables populated 17. Foreign key validation - EventID must reference valid Event (if provided) 18. Company ownership validation - CompanyID must reference valid Company 19. Comprehensive UAT tests validate all form header operations and access control

story-context.constraints: - Company-scoped form access required (users only see their company's forms) - Role-based access control required (creator, company admin, system admin) - EventID foreign key nullable (forms can exist without event association) - Form soft delete required (IsDeleted flag, not hard delete) - All form actions logged with user ID and timestamp - Form list load time: < 2 seconds - Form creation/update: < 1 second - Form detail load: < 1 second - Logging: Use enhanced_diagnostic_logs.py to validate all form actions are logged correctly - Maintain Epic 1 performance characteristics - Preserve all existing Epic 1 functionality without breaking changes - Foundation for Epic 3 Form Builder (form header structure ready)
